summary: Focused re-verification of AppHeader title truncation bug fix (iter156 follow-up). Confirmed AppHeader now uses numberOfLines={2} on both title and subtitle (/app/mobile/src/components/ui.tsx lines 62 and 66). At 375px mobile viewport after logging in as cathy@example.com: /amendments renders the FULL title 'Care-Plan Changes' wrapped across 2 lines (Text node cw=181 sw=181, no horizontal overflow, no ellipsis dots visible in screenshot), and /athm renders the FULL 'AT & HM Projects' wrapped across 2 lines (Text node cw=181 sw=181). Regression sweep: /compare-providers title 'Compare Providers' fits on 1 line unchanged, /provider-switch 'Switch Provider' renders without truncation, tab headers still OK, no visual breakage from the 2-line change. Dark-mode retest via Settings > theme-dark: both /amendments and /athm continue to show full titles with the correct dark contrast. Note: /statement-audit/<id> could not be verified in this run (route returned 404 for tested statement id) — this is unrelated to the AppHeader change and should be checked separately if needed.

critical_code_review_comments: AppHeader fix is minimal and correct: title & subtitle both set to numberOfLines={2}. Titles longer than ~15 chars now wrap instead of ellipsising. Title column width remains ~181px on 375-viewport screens (with back+right buttons), so the 2-line allowance is what's required for 'Care-Plan Changes' (17 chars) and 'AT & HM Projects' (16 chars) — verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AppHeader in /app/mobile/src/components/ui.tsx already uses numberOfLines={2} on both the title (line 62) and subtitle (line 66) Text components. Any future long titles will wrap to 2 lines rather than truncate. The title column is a flex:1 View next to an optional back button (~40px) and an optional right slot (e.g. 'New' pill ~68px); at 375-viewport this leaves ~180px for the title. Titles that exceed ~2 lines at that width could theoretically still clip — main agent should keep header titles ≤ ~30 chars or add a fallback (numberOfLines={3}) if longer strings appear. Statement-audit route wasn't fully validated in this run — recommend adding a smoke check next iter.
rca of the issue: Root cause was AppHeader Title/Subtitle Text components using numberOfLines={1}, which forces horizontal ellipsis when text exceeds container width. Fix (already applied): change to numberOfLines={2} so long titles wrap to a second line. Verified visually + via DOM probe (scrollWidth == clientWidth on the title Text on both /amendments and /athm; height doubled from 34→68 px indicating 2 lines rendered; no ellipsis rendered in the DOM). Confirmed working in both light and dark themes.
